local_review.finding_body: metadata/org.eclipse.jetty/jetty-util/12.0.9/reachability-metadata.json registered the bundle org_eclipse_jetty.jetty_util.loader even though that bundle is supplied only by tests/src/org.eclipse.jetty/jetty-util/12.0.9/src/test/resources/org_eclipse_jetty/jetty_util/loader.properties. Shipping test-owned metadata violates the required library/test metadata split.
local_review.finding_title: Test-only resource bundle shipped as library metadata
local_review.fix_note: Moved the loader resource-bundle registration from the shipped reachability metadata into the test-only META-INF/native-image/reachability-metadata.json. This preserves LoaderTest's native behavior while preventing test-only configuration from reaching consumers.
local_review.review_comment: Approved after correction. The diff is scoped to org.eclipse.jetty:jetty-util:12.0.9, raises dynamic-access coverage from 7.27% (4/55) to 96.36% (53/55), and adds library-specific public-API tests without native skips, swallowed failures, exact-version assertions, library-package placement, or legacy metadata files. The repaired tree passed checkMetadataFiles, checkstyle, spotlessCheck, JVM tests, native-image compilation, and all 15 native tests.
